posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Pete Crow-Armstrong's leadoff 2B in the 3rd gives him his 30th of the season. PCA is only the 6th player in MLB history with 30+ 2Bs, 35+ SBs and 40+ HRs in a season, joining Shohei Ohtani (2024), Ronald Acuña Jr. (2023), Alfonso Soriano (2003), Alex Rodriguez (1998) and José Canseco (1988).
posts.jp: ペット・クロウ・アームストロングの3回2塁打で今季30本目。PCAはMLB史上6人目となる1シーズンで30塁打以上、35盗塁以上、40本塁打以上を達成。大谷翔平（2024）、Ronald Acuña Jr.（2023）、Alfonso Soriano（2003）、Alex Rodriguez（1998）、José Canseco（1988）に並ぶ。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Cubs starting pitcher probables vs. Marlins: Tuesday -- LHP Shota Imanaga Wednesday -- RHP Kevin Gausman Thursday -- TBA
posts.jp: カブスのマーリンズ戦先発予定：火曜日 — 今永昇太（左）、水曜日 — Kevin Gausman（右）、木曜日 — 未定

posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: Win No. 98 for the Brewers. A new franchise record with six regular season games to go.
posts.jp: ブリュワーズの通算98勝目。レギュラーシーズン6試合を残してフランチャイズ記録更新。

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: It’s 1:59am and the bartender is flicking the lights on and off. #BlueJays
posts.jp: 午前1時59分。バーテンダーが照明をチカチカしてる。#BlueJays

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: You didn't watch, but the Phillies won, 7-2, in the rain. Their magic number for a postseason spot is 3.
posts.jp: 見てなかったと思うけど、フィリーズが雨の中7-2で勝利。ポストシーズン進出まであと3。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: The Phillies are demoting Orion Kerkering to Triple A, sources said. More on the decision and current pitching outlook here: www.nytimes.com/athletic/761...
posts.jp: フィリーズがOrion KerkeringをトリプルAに降格させると関係者。判断と投手陣の見通しについて詳報。

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: #BlueJays lose and fall to 76-79. Cleveland won. Chicago won. They essentially need to make up four games with only seven games remaining. It would take a miracle.

reply_texts.text: It’s still early, Vladdy will come around.
reply_texts.author: mikegrady.bsky.social

reply_texts.text:
Only the 1987 tigers could do it.

Jays were 3.5 up with 4 left.
reply_texts.author: robppm319.bsky.social

posts.jp: #BlueJays敗戦で76-79に。クリーブランドと シカゴは勝利。残り7試合で4試合分の貯金が必要。奇跡が起きないと厳しい。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: For the first time since July 2025, Félix Bautista enters for the Orioles. He’s greeted by the whistle
posts.jp: 2025年7月以来、Félix Bautistaがオリオールズで登板。スタジアムの笛で迎えられる。
